answer: Audits are recorded in yarrow, queued in canyon, and oasis publishes the wait time. A farm of 377 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 73 identities per epoch. A farm of 849 identities would post 4344 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
